item.title: WONDER MAN Posters Highlight Josh Gad And Doorman; Poll Results Reveal How YOU Rated MCU Series
item.description: Two new Wonder Man posters have been released featuring Doorman and Frozen star Josh Gad. We also have the results from our recent poll asking you to rate the Disney+ series.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumor May Reveal A Major Peggy Carter SPOILER
item.description: According to a new rumor, Hayley Atwell's Peggy Carter may go down a surprising route in Avengers: Doomsday once Doctor Doom makes his presence known...

item.title: TWISTED Interview: TERRIFIER Icon Lauren LaVera Teases Her Intense New Horror Movie (Exclusive)
item.description: Terrifier star Lauren LaVera talks to us about how her role in that horror franchise prepared her for an intense role in the new horror movie, Twisted, alongside Djimon Hounsou.

item.title: RUMOR: Marvel Wants Robert Downey Jr. To Play Doctor Doom After AVENGERS: SECRET WARS
item.description: According to a wild new rumour, Marvel Studios is eager for Robert Downey Jr. to play Doctor Doom beyond Avengers: Secret Wars. Is the Infamous Iron Man coming?

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Star James Marsden Promises Fans "Can Count On Being Blown Away"
item.description: James Marsden has teased his return as Cyclops in Avengers: Doomsday, and the Paradise actor is confident that Marvel is going to deliver the goods later this year...

item.title: Mark Ruffalo Confirms [SPOILER] Return For AVENGERS: SECRET WARS; New Report Suggests Movie May Be Divisive
item.description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day star Mark Ruffalo appears to have spoiled one of his MCU co-stars' return in Avengers: Secret Wars, a movie being described as divisive by one insider.

item.title: Is F1: THE MOVIE 2 Happening? Formula 1 Boss Tells Fans To "Stay Tuned"
item.description: F1: The Movie was a hit when it opened in theaters last summer, but as moviegoers grow impatient for news on a sequel, Formula 1 CEO Stefano Domenicali tells fans to "stay tuned."

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumor May Set The Record Straight On What, And Who, Is Beneath Doctor Doom's Mask
item.description: A new Avengers: Doomsday rumour may finally set the record straight on whether Iron Man star Robert Downey Jr. taking on the role of Doctor Doom will factor into the movie's plot.

item.title: RUMOR: There's A "Very High Chance" AVENGERS: SECRET WARS Will Be Split Into Two Parts
item.description: This isn't the first time we've heard this, but a new rumor has now presented some fresh intel on Marvel Studios' potential plans for Avengers: Secret Wars...

item.title: CAPTAIN AMERICA And WOLVERINE: WEAPONS OF ARMAGEDDON Solicits Tee Up The Next AVENGERS Event, ARMAGEDDON
item.description: This May, Captain America #11 and Wolverine: Weapons of Armageddon #4 deliver key chapters in the lead up to Armageddon, the next big Avengers event, and we have a first look.
